title: The Temple of Sarn in the Marrowmere

statements.text: The temple fell three hundred years ago in the Sundering
Its bell still hangs in the open arch of the tower
The ferryman, Halvard Reis, charges a copper for the crossing
The reeds are being cut for the autumn thatch
the bell is rung only for fog
The last priest, Ysenne, did not drown in the Sundering
she sealed the stair behind her
The stair is still there, hidden behind a fallen column on the north side of the nave
whoever carries it out will be able to calm the lake for a season
Halvard knows this from his grandmother
